findings.cause: The existence check on line 12 is separated from the insert by an awaited getOrder call, so concurrent complete/webhook calls all see no order and each insert their own shop order.

Any capture exception (a lost response or an already-captured error from a parallel attempt) marks the order FAILED without asking PayPal, and it can overwrite an order another caller already marked PAID.
Each call captures with a fresh random request id and never checks whether PayPal already completed the order, so parallel or retried calls attempt multiple captures.
PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED inserts a grant on every delivery, including resends, with no dedupe per PayPal order and SKU and no check that PayPal reports the capture as COMPLETED.
